update_frequency: Rates and membership details are reviewed monthly and after major rate-environment changes; the date above reflects the last full human verification.
_comment: verified_date drives the sitewide 'Last verified' stamp, schema dateModified, and sitemap lastmod. Bump it ONLY when the data in creditunions.json / rates.json / ratings.json has actually been re-checked against the credit unions' live disclosures. A code or design rebuild should NOT change this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
_affiliate_mode: false during seasoning: CTAs link to each credit union's real public site (url field) with rel=nofollow noopener (NOT sponsored). When affiliate applications are approved, put real links in affiliate_url fields of affiliates.json, set this to true, and rebuild.
_settings: ga4_id (G-XXXXXXX), gsc_token (Search Console HTML-tag content value), bing_token, form_action (contact-form endpoint). Leave blank to omit entirely from the built site.
